heading: SELICHOTH
body: FOR THE PROPITIATORY AND PENITENTIAL DAYS, AND FOR THE MINOR FASTS. TO WHICH ARE ADDED THE SELICHOTH FOR THE MINOR DAY OF ATONEMENT With a New English Translation By DAVID ASHER, Ph. Dr. Author of “Outlines of the Jewish Religion” and Translator of Dr. Budinger’s “Way of Faith. LONDON: Published by VALLENTINE & SONS (Succrs.) 31, Duke Street, Aldgate, E.C. 1912-5672.
method: Image-only reading from overlapping native-width bands, frozen before opening the same-service existing English readings/XML/OCR in this run. Same-model second pass with prior exposure to earlier encoding and rendered excerpts; not independent-person proofreading. Whitespace and physical line wrapping normalized; typographic detail adjudicated separately.
limitations: The printed Way of Faith quotation appears to lack its closing quotation mark. The Budinger surname has no visible umlaut in this image; inspect against encoded title. Title typography and line divisions need separate comparison.
